javascript:(function () { const OVERLAY_ID = 'd3-grab-box'; const FILE_PREFIX = 'd3-shopee-price'; const match = location.href.match(/-i\.(\d+)\.(\d+)/) || location.href.match(/product\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/); if (!match) { alert('这不是虾皮商品页，请在商品页点这个书签。'); return; } const shopId = match[1]; const itemId = match[2]; const toRm = (value) => (value == null || value < 0 ? null : value / 100000); const clean = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const isoStamp = () => new Date().toISOString(); const parseDisplayedPrice = (text) => { const match = clean(text).match(/RM\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)/i); if (!match) return null; const value = Number(match[1].replace(/,/g, '')); return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null; }; const safeSlug = (value) => clean(value) .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-') .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') .slice(0, 48) || 'item'; const removeBox = () => document.getElementById(OVERLAY_ID)?.remove(); const saveFile = (filename, body, type) => { const blob = new Blob([body], { type }); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = filename; document.body.append(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000); }; const copyText = async (text, button) => { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); if (button) button.textContent = '已复制'; }; const renderBox = (title, lines, actions = []) => { removeBox(); const isNarrow = window.innerWidth < 640; const box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = OVERLAY_ID; box.style.cssText = [ 'position:fixed', 'z-index:999999', isNarrow ? 'left:8px' : 'right:20px', isNarrow ? 'right:8px' : '', isNarrow ? 'top:8px' : 'top:20px', isNarrow ? 'bottom:8px' : '', 'width:min(480px,calc(100vw - 32px))', isNarrow ? 'max-width:none' : '', isNarrow ? 'max-height:none' : 'max-height:calc(100vh - 40px)', 'background:#fffaf3', 'border:2px solid #c9a96e', 'border-radius:14px', isNarrow ? 'padding:12px' : 'padding:16px 18px', 'box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)', 'font:13px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif', 'color:#222', 'display:flex', 'flex-direction:column', ].join(';'); const heading = document.createElement('div'); heading.textContent = title; heading.style.cssText = 'font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;flex:0 0 auto'; box.append(heading); const body = document.createElement('div'); body.style.cssText = [ 'white-space:pre-wrap', 'overflow:auto', 'min-height:0', 'flex:1 1 auto', 'padding-right:4px', '-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch', ].join(';'); body.textContent = lines.join('\n'); box.append(body); if (actions.length) { const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.style.cssText = [ 'display:flex', 'flex-wrap:wrap', 'gap:8px', 'margin-top:12px', 'padding-top:12px', 'border-top:1px solid rgba(165,132,66,.25)', 'background:#fffaf3', 'flex:0 0 auto', ].join(';'); for (const action of actions) { const button = document.createElement('button'); button.textContent = action.label; button.style.cssText = [ 'padding:9px 11px', 'border:1px solid #a58442', 'border-radius:8px', 'background:#fff', 'cursor:pointer', 'font:inherit', isNarrow ? 'flex:1 1 calc(50% - 8px)' : '', ].join(';'); button.onclick = async () => { try { await action.onClick(button); } catch (error) { alert(error.message || String(error)); } }; bar.append(button); } box.append(bar); } const close = document.createElement('button'); close.textContent = '关闭'; close.style.cssText = [ 'margin-top:12px', 'padding:9px 11px', 'border:0', 'background:#222', 'color:#fff', 'border-radius:8px', 'cursor:pointer', 'font:inherit', 'flex:0 0 auto', isNarrow ? 'padding-bottom:calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))' : '', ].join(';'); close.onclick = removeBox; box.append(close); document.body.append(box); }; const normalize = (item) => { const tiers = item.tier_variations || []; const variants = (item.models || []).map((model) => { let name = clean(model.name); if (!name && Array.isArray(model.extinfo?.tier_index)) { name = model.extinfo.tier_index .map((optionIndex, tierIndex) => tiers[tierIndex]?.options?.[optionIndex]) .filter(Boolean) .join(' / '); } const originalPrice = toRm(model.price); const promoPrice = toRm(model.promotion_price); const currentPrice = promoPrice ?? originalPrice; return { name: name || '默认款式', currentPrice, originalPrice, promoPrice, stock: model.stock ?? null, inStock: model.stock !== 0, }; }); if (!variants.length) { const originalPrice = toRm(item.price); const promoPrice = toRm(item.price_before_discount); variants.push({ name: '默认款式', currentPrice: originalPrice, originalPrice, promoPrice, stock: item.stock ?? null, inStock: item.stock !== 0, }); } return { schemaVersion: 1, grabbedAt: isoStamp(), pageUrl: location.href, shopId, itemId, sellerName: clean(item.shop_name || item.shopid || ''), title: clean(item.title || item.name || document.title || '未命名商品'), currency: 'MYR', variants, }; }; const normalizeFromPage = () => { const title = clean(document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]')?.content) || clean(document.title) || '未命名商品'; const sellerName = clean(document.querySelector('meta[property="og:site_name"]')?.content) || clean(document.querySelector('a[href*="/shop/"]')?.textContent) || ''; const optionButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((button) => { const text = clean(button.textContent); return text && /^(?:\d+\+\d+GB|Black|White|Blue|Violet|Purple|Pink|Gray|Grey)/i.test(text); }); const names = optionButtons .map((button) => clean(button.textContent)) .filter(Boolean) .slice(0, 12); const priceText = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')) .map((node) => clean(node.textContent)) .find((text) => /RM\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?/.test(text)); const currentPrice = parseDisplayedPrice(priceText); const variants = names.length ? names.map((name) => ({ name, currentPrice, originalPrice: currentPrice, promoPrice: null, stock: null, inStock: true, })) : [{ name: '页面当前选项', currentPrice, originalPrice: currentPrice, promoPrice: null, stock: null, inStock: true, }]; return { schemaVersion: 1, grabbedAt: isoStamp(), pageUrl: location.href, shopId, itemId, sellerName, title, currency: 'MYR', variants, source: 'page-fallback', }; }; const toSummaryLines = (record) => { const header = [ '店铺ID: ' + record.shopId, '商品ID: ' + record.itemId, '款式数: ' + record.variants.length, '抓取时间: ' + record.grabbedAt, '', ]; const variantLines = record.variants.map((variant) => { const price = variant.currentPrice == null ? 'N/A' : 'RM' + variant.currentPrice; const original = variant.originalPrice != null && variant.currentPrice != null && variant.originalPrice !== variant.currentPrice ? ' (原RM' + variant.originalPrice + ')' : ''; const stock = variant.inStock ? '' : ' [缺货]'; return `• ${variant.name}: ${price}${original}${stock}`; }); return header.concat(variantLines); }; const toJson = (record) => JSON.stringify(record, null, 2); const toCsv = (record) => { const rows = [ [ 'grabbed_at', 'title', 'seller_name', 'page_url', 'shop_id', 'item_id', 'variant_name', 'current_price', 'original_price', 'promo_price', 'in_stock', 'stock', ], ]; for (const variant of record.variants) { rows.push([ record.grabbedAt, record.title, record.sellerName, record.pageUrl, record.shopId, record.itemId, variant.name, variant.currentPrice ?? '', variant.originalPrice ?? '', variant.promoPrice ?? '', variant.inStock ? 'true' : 'false', variant.stock ?? '', ]); } return rows .map((row) => row .map((value) => `"${String(value ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`) .join(',') ) .join('\n'); }; renderBox('D3 抓价中…', ['正在用你当前登录会话读取 Shopee 价格接口。']); fetch('/api/v4/pdp/get_pc?item_id=' + itemId + '&shop_id=' + shopId, { headers: { 'x-api-source': 'pc', 'x-shopee-language': 'en', }, credentials: 'include', }) .then((response) => response.json().then((payload) => ({ response, payload })) ) .then(({ response, payload }) => { const item = payload && payload.data && payload.data.item; if (!item) { renderBox('D3 抓价失败', [ '接口没有返回商品数据。', 'HTTP: ' + response.status, '错误码: ' + (payload && payload.error != null ? payload.error : '未知'), '先刷新页面再点一次；还不行就是这次会话被软拦截了。', ]); return; } let record = normalize(item); if (!record.variants.length || record.variants.every((variant) => variant.currentPrice == null)) { record = normalizeFromPage(); } const json = toJson(record); const csv = toCsv(record); const summary = [record.title].concat(toSummaryLines(record)).join('\n'); const stamp = record.grabbedAt.replace(/[:.]/g, '-'); const base = FILE_PREFIX + '-' + safeSlug(record.title) + '-' + record.itemId + '-' + stamp; renderBox(record.title, toSummaryLines(record), [ { label: '复制摘要', onClick: function (button) { return copyText(summary, button); }, }, { label: '复制 JSON', onClick: function (button) { return copyText(json, button); }, }, { label: '复制 CSV', onClick: function (button) { return copyText(csv, button); }, }, { label: '下载 JSON', onClick: function (button) { saveFile(base + '.json', json, 'application/json'); button.textContent = '已下载'; }, }, { label: '下载 CSV', onClick: function (button) { saveFile(base + '.csv', csv, 'text/csv;charset=utf-8'); button.textContent = '已下载'; }, }, ]); }) .catch((error) => { const record = normalizeFromPage(); const json = toJson(record); const csv = toCsv(record); const summary = [record.title].concat(toSummaryLines(record)).join('\n'); const stamp = record.grabbedAt.replace(/[:.]/g, '-'); const base = FILE_PREFIX + '-' + safeSlug(record.title) + '-' + record.itemId + '-' + stamp; renderBox(record.title, [ '接口抓取失败，已降级为页面可见价格抓取。', '原因: ' + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)), '', ].concat(toSummaryLines(record)), [ { label: '复制摘要', onClick: function (button) { return copyText(summary, button); }, }, { label: '复制 JSON', onClick: function (button) { return copyText(json, button); }, }, { label: '下载 JSON', onClick: function (button) { saveFile(base + '.json', json, 'application/json'); button.textContent = '已下载'; }, }, { label: '下载 CSV', onClick: function (button) { saveFile(base + '.csv', csv, 'text/csv;charset=utf-8'); button.textContent = '已下载'; }, }, ]); }); })();
